categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds GitHub Actions workflow and helper scripts in .github/ to run automated builds and tests against open PR merge commits.
categories.rationale: Adds a periodic CI workflow to detect semantic merge breakages across open pull requests. This reduces maintainer friction by catching clean-merging build or test failures early without requiring manual retesting.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and introduces an automated harness to run the test suite against speculative merge commits across open pull requests.
categories.rationale: Provides an automated mechanism to detect semantic test failures caused by newly merged master changes. It adds automated test execution coverage for pending PRs rather than improving test framework signal directly.
